review_notes: I read the whole file and checked it for duplicated proof blocks. The candidates were the five `Witness.exterior_*` lemmas, the F/U branch pairs, the `regularDomain_open`/`relaxedDomain_open`/`trueDomain_open` trio, and the repeated `E`-germ congruences. I judged all of these too short, or just thin wrappers around existing API. The one real repetition is the region-inclusion bookkeeping. `LoopData.union_full` and `LoopData.boundary_subset` are re-proved almost term for term as `hKT`, `hST` and `hBT` inside `NominalBounds.exists_loopData`. Only the structure supplying `modulation` and `before_repair` differs. The same pair-membership case split also appears in `hbdy` and in `true_boundary` in `nominalBounds_of_certificate`. The mathematics is elementary interval ordering, so the benefit is modest. I did not run Lean, so the proposed lemmas are untested. I did not check how many other files redo this interval bookkeeping.

findings.problem: These three inclusions repeat the proofs of `LoopData.union_full` and `LoopData.boundary_subset`. The only difference is that the `modulation` window and `before_repair` come from `NominalBounds b` instead of `LoopData d`. The proofs use the same ordering chain `hp.1.2.trans (before_repair.trans (repairPatch W).ordered).le`. They also use the same `Set.mem_insert_iff` / `Set.mem_singleton_iff` case split on `{v.left, v.right}`. That split appears again in `hbdy` and in `true_boundary` of `nominalBounds_of_certificate`. Any change to the region definitions (for example, closed versus open `repairPatch` ends) has to be made in each copy.
findings.proposed_change:
Add region lemmas that depend only on the window `v`, the radius `a` and the hypothesis `hb : v.right < (repairPatch W).left`.

1. `modulationRegion_subset_full (W) (v) (a) (hb) : modulationRegion v a ⊆ fullRegion W v a`. Proof: take `hp.1.2.trans (hb.trans (repairPatch W).ordered).le` for the right end, and keep the left end and the `band` component.
2. `followingRegion_subset_full (W) (v) (a) : followingRegion W v a ⊆ fullRegion W v a`. Proof: `v.ordered.le.trans hp.1.1`.
3. `boundaryRegion_subset_modulation (v) (a) : boundaryRegion v a ⊆ modulationRegion v a`. This is the case split currently written out in `LoopData.boundary_subset`.

Then `LoopData.union_full` becomes `Set.union_subset (modulationRegion_subset_full ..) (followingRegion_subset_full ..)`. `LoopData.boundary_subset` becomes the generic lemma at `d.modulation`. In `exists_loopData`, `hKT`, `hST` and `hBT` become `modulationRegion_subset_full W b.modulation w.inner b.before_repair`, `followingRegion_subset_full ..`, and `(modulationRegion_subset_full ..) ∘ (boundaryRegion_subset_modulation ..)`. The positivity proof in `hbdy` can reuse `boundaryRegion_subset_modulation`, since `modulationRegion` gives `v.left ≤ p.1`.
findings.benefit: There is one proof of the interval-ordering facts instead of two or three. The `exists_loopData` proof is shorter, and the relation between `LoopData` and `NominalBounds` regions is stated once. The window ordering and the gap before the repair patch are no longer re-derived whenever a structure carries them.
